title: BA1/306/2024 of SUBHANKAR VISWAS Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
First Bail Application No.306 of 2024
Subhankar Viswas ........Applicant

Present:-
Mr. D.N. Sharma, Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. M.A. Khan, A.G.A. with Mr. Pramod Tiwari, Brief Holder
for State.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)
 Applicant Subhankar Viswas is in judicial
custody in FIR No.02 of 2024, under Sections
8/22/29/60 of the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic
Substances Act, 1985 ("the Act"), Police Station
Pulbhatta, District Udham Singh Nagar. He has sought
his release on bail.
2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and
perused the record.
3. According to the FIR, on 03.01.2024, narcotic
substance was recovered from the co-accused. They
reveal that they brought the substance from the
applicant.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant would
submit that except the statement of the co-accused, there
is no material against the applicant; nothing was
recovered from him. He is not a previous convict.

2
5. Learned State Counsel admits that based on
the statement of the co-accused, the applicant has been
implicated in the instant case. He admits that the bail
rejection order does not reveal any previous conviction of
the applicant.
6. Having considered, this Court is of the view
that the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.
7. The bail application is allowed.
8. Let the applicant be released on bail, on his
executing a personal bond and furnishing two reliable
sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the
court concerned.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J)
 26.02.2024
Ravi
